domain_hint: Avionics cold plate CHT model for electronics cooling in vacuum using 30% water–glycol
ambiguity_notes:
- Near-wall treatment: early claim of y+ < 1 everywhere conflicts with later report of median y+ ≈ 7 and areas up to 25
- Property modeling: slide says temperature-dependent properties enabled; later notes constant-property decks were used (PGW and copper at 40 C)
- Test correlation accuracy: “within 5%” stated for temperatures, but a 12% local deviation (11.8 K) is reported at TC7
- Energy balance: stated 0.5% closure vs later 2.7% mismatch
- Contact resistance: coupon shows 1.5e−4 m2K/W; model baseline uses 5e−5 m2K/W without test basis
- Range-of-use: applicability limited to ≤60 C inlet, yet scenario S4 analyzed at 85 C and 500 W
